summary: Wayfire remains the installed backend after the layout authority proof, but layout rules and placement policy move into backend-neutral Rust layout model work. The Wayfire bridge/plugin should apply rectangles and report acknowledgements, not own product layout policy.

evidence.finding: Wayfire exposes enough direct lifecycle, geometry, focus, workspace, stacking, and primitive placement API to attempt a bounded custom plugin proof. Stock simple-tile remains evidence only.
The installed service reported compositor-owned primary and secondary geometry for two native surfaces and capture-visible non-overlap.
compositorctl and /api layout actions assigned real native surfaces to distinct zones, reported layout state, classified unsupported actions, captured output evidence, and cleaned up surfaces.
Rust layout-model owns backend-neutral command result semantics, revisions, stale/missing/backend-unsupported classes, focus/order, zones, and geometry updates.
Smithay remains parked because the Wayfire proof passed inside the churn budget. It can start if future evidence trips the documented stop criteria.

churnBudget.result: The proof completed as a bounded Wayfire plugin and bridge adapter series without synthetic keyboard shortcuts, screenshot-derived geometry, shell inference, governance coupling, shell UI coupling, or Smithay promotion.
churnBudget.followUpShape: Further work should be feature implementation on a backend-neutral Rust layout planner, not additional Wayfire proof churn.

mangoLessons: Treat layouts as selectable planner algorithms separate from backend application.
Keep monitor/output work areas, tag/workspace state, client order, per-client ratios, and gap policy as planner inputs.
Represent recursive split layouts such as dwindle as explicit tree state, then assign rectangles from that tree.
Keep window rules and layout selection outside backend protocol code.

nextImplementationParent.title: Backend-agnostic tiling layout planner implementation series
nextImplementationParent.intent: Implement layout rules in Rust so Wayfire, Smithay, or another future backend only needs an adapter that applies planned rectangles and reports truthful acknowledgement state.
